title: AWATEA - Hakvoort 45m
highlights: Tender garage converting into a beach club
description:
Stylish and capable, AWATEA is a 45-metre Royal Hakvoort motor yacht with a five-stateroom layout including a full-beam master, well-proportioned spaces, a great sky lounge and a tender garage that converts into a proper beach club.

Punching above her 499 GT, she shows in pristine condition thanks to an open-checkbook maintenance programme. Twin Caterpillar engines give a range of 4,600 nautical miles. She is lying in Urk, the Netherlands.
